title_zh: PESI 免費網上培訓：醫療創傷——治療健康危機後的 PTSD、焦慮與抑鬱
title_en: PESI free virtual training: medical trauma clinical tools for PTSD anxiety and depression after a health crisis
summary_zh: Sacha McBain 與 Michelle Flaum 主講，教臨床工作者評估醫療創傷壓力，運用醫療創傷生態模式做個案概念化，並以認知重構、行為實驗及健康與復康心理學策略處理 PTSD、焦慮與抑鬱。內容包括創傷訪談、健康相關焦慮、污名與有毒正能量等議題。
summary_en: Sacha McBain and Michelle Flaum teach clinicians to assess medical traumatic stress, conceptualise cases with a medical trauma ecological model, and treat PTSD, anxiety and depression with cognitive restructuring, behavioural experiments and health and rehabilitation psychology strategies. Topics include trauma interviewing, health-related anxiety, stigma and toxic positivity.
caution: 免費參加；學分須另外付費，原頁未列金額。報名頁為 PESI 銷售鏡像站，未見 pesi.com 原站本活動頁。
